//: Copy to setup.local.json (never committed) and fill in. docs/owner/OWNER-GUIDE.md (Part A) explains each value.

cloudflare.accountId: 32 hex characters: dashboard → Workers & Pages → Account ID
cloudflare.apiToken: an API token with Account: Cloudflare Pages Edit, D1 Edit, Workers R2 Storage Edit, Workers Scripts Edit (plus Zone Read + DNS Edit only for --add-domain)

razorpay.keyId: rzp_test_… (rzp_live_… only for npm run go-live)
razorpay.keySecret: the key secret Razorpay shows once when the key is generated

email.//: Optional. The sender of sign-in links and receipts: an address on apexDomain, which must be onboarded in Email Service → Email Sending.
